text: dsh-thought-buddy 是面向 DSH Web 的界面插件，会在会话的思考状态提示前添加一个可配置的小伙伴。它通过 dsh-loader 的 conversation.status 挂载点接入状态栏，默认显示 GrokBot 风格的 SVG 动画头像，也可改为轮播自定义表情。头像具有表情变化、眨眼和轻摆效果，并联动轮换状态文字；用户可以启停显示、选择模式、调整尺寸和编辑表情列表。适合希望让 DSH Web 思考状态更醒目、更有个性的人。运行时配置由 loader 管理，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-thought-buddy adds a companion to the DSH Web thinking indicator using dsh-loader's status slot. It displays an animated avatar or rotates emojis. The avatar changes expression and animates status text. Users can choose a mode, set size, and edit emojis. No API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH Web 的思考状态旁边显示一个会动的小头像。
DSH 显示正在思考时，能不能加个动画搭子？
我想把会话状态栏里的思考提示换成更活泼的样子。
让等待模型回复时的状态提示出现会眨眼的 SVG 头像。
有没有办法让思考状态的文字和小表情一起变化？
我希望在 DSH 网页端选择动画头像或自定义 emoji 轮播。
Can I add a small animated companion to the DSH Web thinking indicator?
I want the waiting status to show a blinking avatar or a rotating emoji.
dsh-thought-buddy 的功能「动画头像」：思考状态出现时，在状态栏前方绘制会变换表情、眨眼并轻摆的 SVG 小头像。启用后自动挂载，无需手动触发。
dsh-thought-buddy 的功能「表情轮播」：可切换到 emoji 模式，客户端按配置列表依次显示表情并为切换添加弹跳动画。满足条件的思考状态出现时自动启动。
dsh-thought-buddy 的功能「状态文字打字机」：头像每次切换表情时，状态提示会逐字删去旧词并打出列表中的新词。功能随动画头像自动运行。
dsh-thought-buddy 的功能「外观配置」：通过 loader 的插件配置表单启停小伙伴、选择头像或表情模式、设置尺寸并维护 emoji 列表。更改配置后客户端会重新读取并应用。

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · dsh-thought-buddy：`dsh-thought-buddy` is a Web plugin with profile-backed configuration for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) Web GUI. While the model is working, the status pill that reads `Deep diving...` grows a tiny Grok-style robot avatar: it blinks, swaps expressions with a springy morph, wanders its gaze, and gently bobs — all drawn live as **SVG via `requestAnimationFrame`**, with no additional animation library. Every time the avatar switches expression, the status text rewrites itself with a typewriter effect (deleting character by character, then typing out the next word).

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · dsh-thought-buddy：The avatar animation is ported from [nasawz/GrokBot](https://github.com/nasawz/GrokBot) (a pure Flutter `CustomPaint` widget) to the web: all 25 expressions × 2 eyes × 48-point eye rings, 18 body shapes, and 39 states with their expression/blink cadences are preserved.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · Features：| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| GrokBot avatar | thinking-state expression pool `[8,16,14,17,5]` cycles automatically; springy morph between expressions; 320 ms blinks (random 3.5–7 s interval); spherical head-turn projection + wandering gaze; gentle 1.7 s breathing bob |
| Expression-synced typewriter | on every expression switch, the status text leaves `Deep diving...` via a typewriter effect (delete character by character, pause, then type out the next word) cycling through 55 candidates (`Accomplishing`…`Working`), e.g. `Reticulating...`; React re-renders never overwrite it (the text fiber's children string never changes, so React bails out) |
| Emoji mode | fallback mode that cycles an emoji list (default `🤿 🫧 🌊 🐙 🔍 🧠 💭`) with a pop-in on every switch |
| Theme aware | follows `prefers-color-scheme`: light `#5b7fe5/#fffdf7`, dark `#6689ea/#181a15` (matching the DSH theme) |
| Reduced motion | under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the bob and head-turn sway are disabled; expression changes and blinks remain |
| Self-cleaning | the animation stops as soon as the status pill leaves the DOM; inserted nodes survive React r

Install the @dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy plugin into the profile I specify (or ask me if I didn't name one). The npm package name is `@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy`; use the GitHub source `github:dsh-plugins/dsh-thought-buddy`, or `file:<path>` / `link:<path>` for local development.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · Install from a local checkout (`link:`)：1. Build the artifacts: `npm run build` → compiles TypeScript and produces `lib/client.js` + `lib/index.js`
2. In the profile, run `pnpm install` (works offline)
3. **Restart `dsh web`** — the client-module manifest is composed at boot, so a new bundle needs a restart
4. Refresh the page and send the model a message

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · 2.0.0 configuration and migration：Requires Node.js 24.9+ and dsh-loader 2.x. Supports the loader's explicit `0.1.5`, `0.1.6`, `0.1.7`, `0.2.0`, `0.2.1` and `0.2.2` release families, including prereleases.

Loader's config-api stores preferences at `<profile>/config/dsh-thought-buddy/config.json`. Before `0.1.6-alpha.2`, open **Settings → Plugin configuration**; from that version, use the plugin detail page. The card starts collapsed. Saving immediately refreshes the animation. Reset changes the draft until saved.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · 2.0.0 configuration and migration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Show the buddy |
| `mode` | `avatar` | Animated `avatar` or cycling `emoji` |
| `size` | `18` | Size, 8–64 px |
| `emojis` | `🤿 🫧 🌊 🐙 🔍 🧠 💭` | Nonempty array of emoji strings |

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · 2.0.0 configuration and migration：1.x localStorage keys are no longer read or imported automatically. Re-enter old preferences in the form. Each profile has its own configuration; uninstalling retains the file. Unload cancels the subscription and animation, including configuration reads that complete later.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · Development and architecture：```sh
npm ci
npm run gen         # regenerate when upstream GrokBot data changes
npm run typecheck
npm run build

The host entry registers a config-api template. The client reads and subscribes to preferences, mounts the SVG/typewriter with `dshLoaderUi.mount`, and cleans up on update or unload.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy README · Development and architecture：`src/config.ts` contains browser-safe defaults and types; `src/config-template.ts` is host-only. tsdown bundles client ESM into a `__ModuleLoader__.load` factory. The client declares the `dshLoaderUi` service dependency; package metadata declares the loader client module dependency.

`test/verify.mjs` checks the built bundle's SVG, animation cadence, typewriter, live configuration changes and unload during an asynchronous read. The original geometry and animation engine are retained.
